run_release_docs: run the release_docs.py script with a version number to branch Google Test wiki pages for a new release
create_WikiBrancher: create a WikiBrancher instance with a dot version string to prepare branching of wiki files
branch_WikiBrancher_BranchFiles: branch wiki files using WikiBrancher.BranchFiles to copy files with a version prefix via svn cp
update_WikiBrancher_UpdateLinksInBranche: update links in branched wiki files using WikiBrancher.UpdateLinksInBranchedFiles to replace page references with versioned names
use_DropWikiSuffix: use DropWikiSuffix to remove the .wiki suffix from a wiki filename string
